text:
alex_w: Hey - onboarding sample app (pagination example) is getting completely stuck under client-side throttling. Repro steps below, curious if this is a bug or just docs missing.

maria_g: ugh, that sounds familiar. Is this the sampleapp that walks through embeddings->search->paginate? :thinking_face:

alex_w: Yep. Steps: run the sample with --page-size=100 and stream results concurrently (we do 8 parallel requests). After a burst of 429s, the client backoffs aggressively and then the paginator stops emitting new pages for like 30s.

sydney: can you paste the logs? specifically the SDK retry/backoff headers and any meter/permits

alex_w: log snippet:

```
[2026-03-20T14:12:01Z] INFO paginator: requesting page=2
[2026-03-20T14:12:01Z] WARN api: 429 Rate limit exceeded (x-retry-after=1)
[2026-03-20T14:12:01Z] INFO throttle: sleeping 1000ms (tokens=0)\n[2026-03-20T14:12:11Z] INFO throttle: recovered tokens=1\n[2026-03-20T14:12:41Z] INFO paginator: stuck waiting for tokens
```

alex_w: Notice the long gap after recovered tokens=1. The client seems to apply a conservative refill policy, so the paginator's concurrent workers all starve.

maria_g: Which SDK version? We changed the token-bucket default in v0.8 for burst smoothing.

alex_w: We're on 0.7.3 (sample app bundled the older dependency). Does 0.8 change retry semantics? I'm worried onboarding folks hit this and think Redwood is flaky.

sydney: yes, 0.8 introduced smoother refill + per-paginator permits. 0.7's global throttle could deadlock paginators if every worker tried to grab tokens at once. We made it default to jittered refill and allow a small burst window.

jordan_ops: tagging @devex - can we update the quickstart or sample app to either pin sdk>=0.8 or set paginator concurrency to 2 by default? Oncall teams will see incidents otherwise.

devex-bot: Created issue #4123: "sampleapp: paginator stalls under client-side throttle (upgrade SDK or reduce concurrency)" - https://redwood/issue/4123

maria_g: For a quick patch: change the sample's ThrottleConfig to {maxTokens: 8, refillMs: 250, jitter: true} and set default pageConcurrency=2. That keeps throughput but avoids simultaneous token grabs.

alex_w: I can PR that. Also adding a note in README explaining SDK parity and that older SDKs may need config adjustments. Will also add a repro script that runs heavy load locally.

sydney: sounds good. Once the PR is up I can validate against dedicated infra to ensure we don't mask server-side 429s.

alex_w: PR opened: https://redwood/pr/787 - includes config + repro script + short note in README. Please review.

maria_g: Reviewed and left one comment about naming the env var REDWOOD_PAGINATOR_CONCURRENCY (consistency). Minor.

jordan_ops: :+1: rolling the change to sampleapp on next deploy. Thanks for catching this, alex.

alex_w: thanks everyone. Filing a follow-up doc in devex/playbooks about recommended client throttle defaults for different deployment types.

devex-bot: Linked issue #4123 to PR 787 and added 'onboarding' label.
